questions.question: What is the purpose of the "super" keyword in Java and other similar languages?

options.A: It refers to the superclass in inheritance
options.B: It creates a new object instance

questions.explanation: super refers to the immediate superclass, used to call its constructor or overridden methods. Objects are created with new.

questions.question: Which of the following devices is essential to set up a wired LAN?
questions.explanation: Every device on a wired LAN needs a Network Interface Card to connect to the network medium. A modem, repeater or firewall is not essential for a basic LAN.

questions.question: Which of the following gives the nth element of the Array?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Array indexing starts at 0, so the nth element is at index n-1. array[n] is actually the (n+1)th element.

questions.concept: RAM and ROM as main memory
questions.question: The two kinds of main memory are
questions.explanation: Main (primary) memory is of two kinds: RAM (volatile, read/write) and ROM (non-volatile, read-only). Primary vs secondary is a classification of all storage, not of main memory.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a valid relational operator used with WHERE clause in SQL?
questions.explanation: SQL uses >, <, =, >=, <= and <> (or !=). '=>' is not a valid relational operator; the correct form is '>='.

questions.question: Which of the following options is a network protocol that enables secure and encrypted file transfers between a client and a server?
questions.explanation: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) provides secure, encrypted file transfer and file management between a client and a server. Telnet and HTTP are unencrypted, and SCP is a simpler SSH-based copy command rather than a full client-server file transfer protocol.

questions.question: In a B-tree of order m, each internal node can have up to ____ children.
questions.explanation: In a B-tree of order m, every node has at most m children and at most m-1 keys. m-1 is the maximum number of keys, not children.

questions.question: The process of removing detail from a given state representation is called ______
questions.explanation: Removing detail from a state representation is called abstraction. Extraction and data mining are unrelated terms.

questions.question: The selected design template can be applied

options.C: To all the new presentations you create

questions.explanation: A design template can be applied to selected slides only, to all slides, or set for all new presentations, so all of these.

questions.question: In memory mapped I/O

options.A: the I/O devices and the memory share the same address space
options.B: the I/O devices have a separate address space
options.C: the memory and I/O devices have an associated address space
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In memory-mapped I/O, I/O device registers are given addresses in the same address space as memory and are accessed with ordinary memory instructions. A separate address space describes I/O-mapped (isolated) I/O.

options.B: The program is compiled and executed successfully
options.C: The program is compiled successfully but throws an error during runtime
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Applying delete to a null pointer is well defined in C++ and does nothing, so the program compiles and runs successfully. No runtime error occurs.

questions.question: The values appearing in given attributes of any tuple in the referencing relation must likewise occur in specified attributes of at least one tuple in the referenced relation, according to _____ integrity constraint.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Referential integrity requires that foreign key values in the referencing relation appear in the referenced relation's key attributes.

questions.question: A technique that was developed to determine whether a machine could or could not demonstrate artificial intelligence is known as the ________?
questions.explanation: The Turing Test, proposed by Alan Turing in 1950, checks whether a machine can exhibit intelligent behaviour indistinguishable from a human.

questions.question: Which of the following is a multimedia authoring tool?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Adobe Flash was a multimedia authoring tool for creating interactive animations and content. Word is a word processor and Photoshop is an image editor.

questions.question: How can you update the values of formula cells if Auto Calculate mode of Excel is disabled?
questions.explanation: F9 recalculates all formulas in open workbooks when calculation is set to manual. F8 is extend selection, F10 activates the menu bar, F11 creates a chart.

questions.question: In the context of minimum spanning trees, the "cut property" is used to justify the correctness of Prim's algorithm. What does the cut property state?

options.A: The algorithm always cuts the maximum weight edge.
options.B: The algorithm always cuts the minimum weight edge.
options.C: The algorithm always cuts an edge crossing the cut with the minimum weight.
options.D: The algorithm always cuts an edge crossing the cut with the maximum weight.

questions.explanation: The cut property says that for any cut of the graph, the minimum-weight edge crossing that cut belongs to some MST; Prim's algorithm picks exactly this edge at each step. It is about edges crossing the cut, not just the globally minimum or maximum edge.

questions.question: Aggregate functions can be used with ________ clause. They can not be used with ________ clause.
questions.explanation: Aggregate functions such as SUM or COUNT can be used in the HAVING clause, which filters groups, but not in the WHERE clause, which filters individual rows before grouping.

questions.question: What does Structured Analysis focus on?
questions.explanation: Structured analysis models a system in terms of data flow and processes, mainly using DFDs, data dictionaries and process specifications.

questions.question: A grammar that produces more than one parse tree for the same sentence is called
questions.explanation: A grammar is ambiguous if some string has more than one parse tree (or leftmost derivation).

questions.question: File manipulation operations in an operating system include:

options.D: Reading, writing, and modifying file content

questions.explanation: File manipulation system calls include create, open, read, write, modify and delete files. Memory allocation and CPU register loading are not file operations.

questions.concept: AND, XOR, OR on binary numbers
questions.question: Given binary numbers A = 101010 and B = 111111, what is the result of (A AND B) OR (A XOR B)?
questions.explanation: A AND B = 101010 and A XOR B = 010101. ORing them gives 111111.

questions.question:
Assertion (A) and Reason (R) based question. Mark the correct choice.
Assertion (A): Every object in Python is assigned a unique identity (ID).
Reason (R): ID remains the same for the lifetime of that object.

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.explanation: Every Python object has a unique identity returned by id(), and this identity stays constant for the object's whole lifetime, which is what makes it a reliable unique identifier. So both statements are true and R explains A.

questions.question: Internet access by transmitting digital data over the wires of a local telephone network is provided by
questions.explanation: Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) provides internet access by sending digital data over existing telephone wires.

questions.question: Which addressing mode involves specifying a value within the instruction itself, rather than referencing a memory location?
questions.explanation: In immediate addressing the operand value is part of the instruction (e.g. MVI A, 05H). Direct addressing gives the memory address of the operand.
